title: whitespace/line_spacing affects gutter icon size
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: Godot_v4.6-stable, Godot_v4.7-dev1 (I did not test older versions) ### System information Godot v4.7.dev1 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21030.2001) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.92 GiB memory ### Issue description as you can see in the provided image, not all gutter icons are scaled instantly after changing whitespace/line_spacing value in editor settings. In my opinion, the icons should not be scaled at all, since the text size is not affected by whitespace/line_spacing, and the same should apply to the icons. Also it would negatively affect the size of CodeEdit. ### Steps to reproduce 1. prerequisites: whitespace/line_spacing is set to default or a smaller amount than the max value - I recommend 0 or the default (4) 2. reload your favorite godot project and set whitespace/line_spacing to a higher value - I recommend the max value (=50) to clearly see the difference. 3. as a temporary fix you have to switch between different scripts or reload the project. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) very trivial bug, MRP should not be necessary. here is a quick video about the live reproduction https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75214d48-4545-4f29-b264-4fb13cbc96d0
